meta.name: google-cloud-networking-observability
meta.description: Investigates Google Cloud networking issues by analyzing logs, metrics, and diagnostics. Use when investigating VPC Flow Logs (including cost estimation), NAT, firewall, or threat logs, querying latency and throughput metrics, or running Connectivity Tests for path diagnostics. Don't use for generic VM management or non-observability tasks.

copy.tagline: 排查谷歌云网络问题，分析日志与指标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你负责谷歌云网络运维，需要快速定位连通性或性能问题
copy.tagline_en: Investigate Google Cloud networking issues by analyzing logs and metrics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Google Cloud networking and need to quickly diagnose connectivity or performance issues

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能分析 Google Cloud 网络日志和指标，帮你排查 VPC 流量、NAT、防火墙、威胁日志等问题，并运行连通性测试。
howto.when: 当你询问 Google Cloud 网络问题，比如查看 VPC Flow Logs、NAT 日志、防火墙规则、延迟指标，或要求运行连通性测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下过去24小时VPC Flow Logs中流量最高的IP。
say.note: Claude 会用 BigQuery 聚合查询并返回结果。

say.text: 检查一下防火墙规则是否阻止了从10.0.0.1到10.0.0.2的流量。
say.note: Claude 会查询防火墙日志并给出结论。

say.text: 运行连通性测试，验证从VM1到VM2的网络路径。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze Google Cloud networking logs and metrics to help troubleshoot VPC flows, NAT, firewall, threat logs, and run Connectivity Tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about Google Cloud networking issues, such as reviewing VPC Flow Logs, NAT logs, firewall rules, latency metrics, or requesting Connectivity Tests.

say_en.text: Find the top IPs by traffic in VPC Flow Logs for the last 24 hours.
say_en.note: Claude will aggregate via BigQuery and return results.

say_en.text: Check if firewall rules block traffic from 10.0.0.1 to 10.0.0.2.
say_en.note: Claude will query firewall logs and conclude.

say_en.text: Run a Connectivity Test from VM1 to VM2.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the test and report findings.
